text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Is that a character from Uma ☆ Love inyour notebook? Did you draw it? It'sso cute!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
M-my friend must have drawn it<n>when I lent her my
notebook. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... What a terrible dream... Myheart's still racing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be busy tomorrow, so<n>I'd better go
back to sleep... Come<n>on... Fall asleep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Agh! I can't sleep at all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober ends up staying awake<n>all night...
